allow: PowerShell($r1 = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:8000/ -UseBasicParsing; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:8000/harvests -UseBasicParsing; $r3 = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:8000/manifest.webmanifest -UseBasicParsing; "root: $\($r1.StatusCode\), SPA deep link: $\($r2.StatusCode\), manifest: $\($r3.StatusCode\)"; \($r1.Content -match '<title>Olive Grove</title>'\))

PowerShell($body = @{date='2026-06-12'; type='Weeding'; notes='test'; tree_ids=@\(1,2\)} | ConvertTo-Json; $a = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:8000/api/activities -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'; "created activity $\($a.id\) on trees: $\(\($a.trees | ForEach-Object label\) -join ','\)"; Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:8000/api/activities/$\($a.id\)" -Method Delete; "deleted OK")

PowerShell(docker run --rm -d --name olive-smoke -p 18000:8000 olive-review-test | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:18000/api/dashboard; "tree_count=$\($r.tree_count\) seasons=$\($r.seasons.Count\) oil_balance=$\($r.oil.balance_kg\)" } finally { docker rm -f olive-smoke | Out-Null })
